---
title: "Check a result for Word (beta)"
description: "Install the plausibility checks and the equation checker as a Word add-in."
---

The add-in puts the checks from [Check a result](checks.html) and the equation checker in a panel beside your document. It runs in Word; nothing you enter leaves your computer.

While it waits for approval in Microsoft's add-in store, it is installed by hand from one small file.

[Download the add-in file (manifest.xml)](addin/manifest.xml){download="check-a-result-manifest.xml" .btn .btn-primary}

## Word on the web (easiest)

1. Open a document in Word on the web.
2. Go to **Home → Add-ins → More add-ins → My add-ins → Upload My Add-in**.
3. Choose the file you downloaded and press **Upload**.

## Word on a Mac

1. In Finder, press **Cmd + Shift + G** and go to
   `~/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Word/Data/Documents/wef`
   (create the `wef` folder if it isn't there).
2. Copy the downloaded file into that folder.
3. Restart Word, open a document, and go to **Home → Add-ins**.

## Word on Windows

1. Put the downloaded file in a folder and share it (right-click the folder → **Properties → Sharing → Share**). Note its network path, such as `\\MY-PC\addins`.
2. In Word, go to **File → Options → Trust Center → Trust Center Settings → Trusted Add-in Catalogs**.
3. Paste the network path into **Catalog Url**, press **Add catalog**, tick **Show in Menu**, and press **OK**.
4. Restart Word, then go to **Home → Add-ins → More add-ins → Shared folder**.

## For a whole organisation

A Microsoft 365 administrator can give it to everyone at once: upload the same file in the Microsoft 365 admin center under **Settings → Integrated apps → Upload custom apps**.

## Updates

You only install it once. The add-in loads from this website, so new checks and fixes appear the next time you open it.

## Privacy and terms

The add-in reads and checks everything on your computer; nothing you select, type or paste is sent anywhere. See the [privacy policy](privacy.qmd) and the [terms of use](terms.qmd).
